rows.text: The record headed 小渕内閣総理大臣記者会見録, 31 July 1998, has 小渕総理 open by saying he has come to bear the heavy responsibility of Prime Minister and later that 'today' he has come to bear responsibility as Prime Minister (本日、私がこうして総理としての責任を負うことになりました).
